messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT detected — 2026-03-05T22:31Z — increased compile backlog causing 503s for dedicated us-west-2. Pager sent to @Dylan (oncall).
Dylan (oncall): Paging ack. Looking into routing/compile queue now.
Alex R: I see a sharp spike in compile latency right at 22:29, looks like the new 'route-compile' change pushed at 22:15.
Maria G: Confirmed. Canary shows new compile routing creating a backlog on router nodes. Initiating mitigation: scale compiler pool and disable routing flag.
Dylan (oncall): Applied mitigation — scaled +2 compiler workers, set feature flag route-compile=off for us-west-2. Watching metrics.
Sam T: Metrics trending down, 503 rate falling from 12% -> 3% in last 6 mins. Tail latency still elevated for long-running batches.
incident-bot: STATUSPAGE DRAFT (for ops review):
```
Incident: Dedicated inference 503s — us-west-2
Start: 2026-03-05 22:29 UTC
Impact: Some Dedicated customers experienced 5xx errors and higher latency while compile routing backlog cleared.
Current status: Mitigation in place; request success rates recovering.
Customer action: No action required. We will follow up with a timeline and root cause once validated.
```
Jordan (CS): Thanks team. Can we have a customer-facing email draft and an internal 1-paragraph RCA for customer ops? Need list of affected accounts (approx count) and proposed credit.
Dylan (oncall): Draft customer note below — please review: 
"Hi — between 22:29–22:45 UTC on 2026-03-05 we observed intermittent 5xx errors affecting Dedicated deployments in us-west-2 due to a routing backlog during a compile-routing change. Mitigation was applied within ~10 minutes and full recovery by 22:45 UTC. We’re investigating root cause and will share an RCA and proposed credit within 3 business days. We apologize for the disruption. Contact support@redwood.ai for questions."
Maria G: +1. Suggest offering a 48-hour service credit for directly impacted accounts. I will compile affected account list and timeline.
Alex R: Note for postmortem — regression in compile routing gating logic allowed increased fanout to stale router set. Need a stricter canary and automatic circuit-breaker.
Sam T: Handoff: I’ll take over monitoring the rollout to ensure no recurrence for next 12 hours. Dylan — leaving detailed notes in the incident channel. :white_check_mark:
Dylan (oncall): Added notes: 
- mitigation steps taken (scale +2, disable flag)
- metrics snapshot attached (link)
- tentative root cause: compile-routing change increased queue pressure when combined with existing slow KV reads
ACTION ITEMS:
- Maria: provide affected account list + timeline (ETA 2026-03-06 14:00 UTC)
- Alex: propose gating/circuit-breaker change and test plan (ETA 2026-03-09)
- Sam: monitor rollout, validate no reoccurrence (12h)
- Jordan (CS): prepare customer email + credit proposal (ETA 2026-03-06)
Dylan (oncall): Passing oncall to @Sam T. If anything spikes, page both Sam and Dylan. Will follow up on RCA draft tomorrow.
Jordan (CS): Copy that. Will draft customer-facing RCA once engineering confirms root cause and preventative actions.
Sam T: Oncall ack. Monitoring dashboard pinned. Will post final status update in this thread when we close the incident.
Dylan (oncall): Thanks all — good containment work. Follow-up postmortem meeting scheduled for 2026-03-07 15:00 UTC to finalize RCA. :thumbsup:
